encounter: E0142 Shirley cap36 - Steel-forward ordering of the block core
availability_audit: Chronology: every source map precedes Jagged Pass in book play order (Route 101-104, 111, 116, 117, Petalburg Woods, Granite Cave, Rusturf Tunnel, Seaspray Cave, Mauville Game Corner). Togepi Route102 land g14 -> friendship Togetic -> Shiny Stone Togekiss g24. Squirtle Mauville Game Corner 500 coins g30 -> Wartortle -> Blastoise g36; Blastoisinite stone-window=14, base-window=36, Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly. Marill Petalburg City old_rod g14 -> Azumarill g20. Swinub Seaspray_Cave_B1F land g14 -> Piloswine -> Mamoswine known-move g36. Abra GraniteCave_1F g20 -> Kadabra -> Alakazam Linking Cord g20. Drilbur RusturfTunnel land g20 -> Excadrill level g36. No legendaries, mythicals, Ultra Beasts or Paradox species; single Mega slot. Ordinary held items from the free Center held-item catalogue.
plan: Same six as the rest of the cap-36 block, reordered so the Steel-type leads. Shirley's team is Fairy-forward (Alcremie Decorate into Pixilate Hyper Voice) and Excadrill is the only member that resists Fairy and hits back at 2x with Iron Head, so it leads instead of sitting in reserve. Mamoswine partners it as a neutral body with Ice priority for the Galarian Mr. Mime. Mega Blastoise is held back because every one of its moves is resisted or neutral against Fairy. Alcremie's Babiri Berry is expected to soften the first Iron Head.
